response.query: Which market-monitoring thresholds (e.g., percent price rise, vendor stock shortage) will trigger predefined remedial steps and what are those steps (pause, caps, phased roll-out)?
response.answer: Market-monitoring thresholds include a 10% price rise or vendor stock shortage triggering pause, caps, or phased roll-out. These steps aim to stabilize markets and prevent supply disruptions.
